Only registered row_intervention differs in their configs. Source-level isolation remains a declared construction claim because candidate source is not exposed.

Both none runs reproduce AUC 0.6151021885074872 and Logloss 0.19653258393542125, all 23 slice dictionaries and selected_parameter_checksum1=778240573. None diagnostic dictionaries do NOT match: inactive role/projected/scale summaries and aggregation distances vary.

All eight call0/1 probes report zero fixed-observer checksum mismatches, zero fixed-observer bit mutations and zero input/parameter/logit mutations. All four runs pass inherited v2 compatibility and initial gates. This supplies the previously missing real-tensor within-run observer check, within the candidate-owned two-call scope.

At all eight probes, fixed-role aggregation repeats have nonzero reported differences: abs_max range [8.242295734817162e-13, 1.9895196601282805e-12], relative range [6.134745326702719e-07, 1.1298074058211472e-06], and bits_mismatches=8 at every probe. These actual-value distances occur in both none and magnitude; their small absolute magnitude must be retained rather than inferred from checksum differences.

At all eight probes, raw backward repeat abs_max/relative are zero; fixed-G/q/h transform repeat abs_max/relative and mask mismatches are zero; result_repeat_relative is zero. Thus frozen-correction/fixed-operand repeat success coexists with nonrepeatability when row aggregation is recomputed. Different controls test different stages.

Within the same-source magnitude pair, input, parameter and raw-table-gradient checksum pairs match at call0 and call1, while roles, projected target, scale, expected-table-gradient and result-gradient sketches differ at both calls. Within none, role/projected/scale sketches differ but expected/result-gradient sketches match. Matching sketches do not certify exact cross-execution common state, and no between-run actual tensor distances or Adam-step differences are exported.

All jobs report two captured slots, 14,661 training calls and 60,045,735 training examples through selected checkpoint; these are candidate counters, not host total processed-example accounting.

Their diagnostics/source version differ from schema3; do not pool them as five interchangeable independent seeds. Missing input and execution failure are not explanations for these successful negative results.
